seo.title: WebP to PNG Converter (Free, Online)
seo.description: Convert WebP images to PNG in your browser, with transparency kept. Free, with no sign-up, and the image never leaves your device.

tool.subtitle: Turn WebP images into PNG files in your browser, transparency included.

faqs.question: Does the PNG keep the WebP's transparency?
faqs.answer: Yes. Transparent and partly transparent areas of the WebP stay that way in the PNG.

faqs.question: What happens to an animated WebP?
faqs.answer: You get a PNG of its first frame. The PNG is a still image, so the other frames are left out.

faqs.question: Will the PNG be larger than the WebP?
faqs.answer: Often. PNG stores every pixel without lossy compression, which tends to take more space than WebP. Converting can't bring back detail a lossy WebP already lost.

faqs.question: Is the WebP's metadata copied to the PNG?
faqs.answer: No. EXIF data, such as camera details and location, and embedded color profiles are left out of the PNG.

faqs.question: Is my WebP uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Your browser decodes the WebP and writes the PNG itself; nothing is sent to a server.

fromFormat.name: WebP
fromFormat.description: An image format developed by Google that supports lossy and lossless compression, transparency and animation.

toFormat.name: PNG
toFormat.description: A lossless image format, standardized as ISO/IEC 15948 and a W3C Recommendation, that every browser opens.
details: Common for screenshots, logos and graphics

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting WebP to PNG
points: Transparency is kept: the PNG has the same transparent areas as the WebP.
An animated WebP gives a PNG of its first frame only.
EXIF data and color profiles aren't copied to the PNG.
Choose several WebP files at once and each PNG downloads on its own.
Everything happens in your browser, so the WebP isn't uploaded.

seo.title: MP4 to MP3 Converter (Free, Online)
seo.description: Convert MP4 video to MP3 audio in your browser: the soundtrack becomes a 192 kbps MP3. Free, with no sign-up, and nothing is uploaded.

tool.subtitle: Save the sound from an MP4 video as a 192 kbps MP3, right in your browser.

faqs.question: What bitrate is the MP3?
faqs.answer: 192 kbps. The sound is re-encoded to MP3 at that constant bitrate with the LAME encoder, whatever the MP4's audio was.

faqs.question: Will the MP3 sound better than the video?
faqs.answer: No. Converting can't add quality the MP4's audio doesn't have, and MP3 is lossy, so the MP3 is at best as good as its source.

faqs.question: What if the MP4 has no sound?
faqs.answer: The conversion fails with an FFmpeg error, because there is no audio track to save. Check that the video plays with sound first.

faqs.question: Is the video uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. FFmpeg runs inside your browser, so the MP4 stays on your device. A long video can take a while on a slow phone or laptop.

fromFormat.name: MP4
fromFormat.description: A container format that can hold video, audio, subtitles and metadata. H.264 video with AAC audio is the most common combination.

toFormat.name: MP3
toFormat.description: A lossy audio format standardized by MPEG that became the most common format for downloadable music.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting MP4 to MP3
points: Only the sound is kept: the video is dropped.
The MP3 is encoded at 192 kbps.
Converting several MP4 files gives one MP3 for each.
An MP4 without an audio track can't be converted.
FFmpeg runs in your browser, so the video isn't uploaded.
